item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Israel rejects Trump’s Gaza peace plan, saying no withdrawal until Hamas disarms
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says his country has rejected the latest US-backed peace plan for Gaza, demanding the full disarmament of Hamas before any Israeli forces withdraw.
